disclosure: Original pattern text; fictional examples where stated. No AI generation in this prototype. Control references are candidate links, not a compliance assessment.

evidence.author: Demo editor
evidence.source: Original fictional interview, reviewed public summary
evidence.text: Fictional incident: an urgent benefits-service patch had to land before the next run. The service owner and release lead agreed on a named decision owner, a stop authority, and a shared evidence log. This kept urgency from erasing responsibility, but coordination took time. It recurs during urgent cross-team changes. A log alone cannot resolve disputed authority; that needs leadership. The team used it in a patch and a rehearsal. Candidate control evidence: decision log with timestamps; controls specialist review remains necessary.

pattern.author: Demo editor
pattern.benefits: Decisions can be reconstructed and challenged.
pattern.boundaries: Assumption: leadership accepts the authority assignment. Competing account: rehearsal may explain success better. Seek an external controls specialist.
pattern.context: Urgent changes crossing service and release teams.
pattern.controls: Candidate organizational control: documented responsibility. Possible evidence: timestamped decision log. GAO Green Book, https://www.gao.gov/greenbook, is a relevant public input for a specialist to vet; no conformance claim.
pattern.exceptions: A log cannot resolve disputed authority.
pattern.forces: Fast delivery; accountable authority; limited coordination time.
pattern.instances: Fictional patch and rehearsal described in the evidence.
pattern.name: A named decision lane
pattern.problem: Urgency obscures who can decide or stop a change.
pattern.resulting_context: Teams have a visible decision route for this change.
pattern.solution: Name a decision owner and stop authority before work begins; keep their decisions in a shared log.

review.note: Reviewed original fictional summaries and original pattern wording; no real participant information. CC0-1.0 applies to the demo content.
